# Pretrained Weights Index

[English](WEIGHTS.md) · [简体中文](WEIGHTS.zh-CN.md)

All 133 papers in [Awesome Neural ISP](README.md) that release pretrained weights, grouped by topic. Links are copied from each repository README (checked 2026-10-11); "in repo" means the checkpoint is committed to the repository. Explicitly labeled third-party weights are included (1 publication(s)).
